description: Deterministic conservative scorecard rules. Every finalized provision receives exactly +1 or -1; comparable prior enacted laws are recorded as the current-law reference and ideological fallback rules are used when no comparable law exists.

calibrated_rules.rationale: Defunding/cutting veterans affairs is neutral (0) by user decision and is not scored.
Gun-rights/open-carry expansion is socially conservative and right of the current baseline.
Expands legal abortion relative to the conservative baseline.
Adds/retains regulatory standards; the bill's own report shows regulatory burden falling, but the provision establishes environmental regulation rather than deregulation.
Raises a government-mandated wage floor above the federal baseline.
Veterans affairs funding/benefits are scored +1 (aligned) by user decision, as a national-defense and veterans commitment.
Expanding H-1B skilled-worker immigration moves policy leftward under the nationalist framework.
Creates universal federal healthcare and increases federal program scope/regulatory burden.
